subject: Procurement: PO field requirements and discount eligibility
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearwave.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO field / invoice cadence question (ClearWave)

Hi Karthik and Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood Dedicated for inference. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of items before we move to a PO:

- Can you confirm which PO fields Redwood requires on the inbound PO for automated processing? (e.g., contract number, cost center, BU code, ship-to)
- We typically run monthly consolidated invoices; for Redwood's pricing bands / slab discounts, do you require invoice-level itemization or will a single monthly invoice showing the PO reference suffice to qualify for committed-discount tiers?
- Also, is Net-30 the default? Procurement is asking if Net-60/Net-90 can be considered for larger commitments.

I attached the PO template they usually send — it has a couple of custom fields (erp_reference and multi_entity_tag). If these can be mapped automatically it will help speed things up.

Appreciate any confirmation or checklist we can pass to our AP team.

Best,
Samantha
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearWave Health
attachments: ClearWave_PO_sample.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearwave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO field / invoice cadence question (ClearWave)

Hi Samantha — great to hear from you, and glad the demo landed well. Quick answers up front, then a proposed next step so we can close the loop with procurement: 

1) Required PO fields for automated ingest:
   - PO number (mandatory)
   - Redwood contract id (we'll provide once SOW signed)
   - Bill-to legal entity (match to invoice legal name)
   - Invoice remit address (if different from bill-to)
   - Cost center / BU code (optional but recommended for multi-entity)
   - ERP reference (we can map erp_reference from your template)

2) Discount / slab qualification:
   - Discounts are calculated at the billing period level. For monthly consolidated invoices we can apply committed-tier pricing provided the invoice references the PO and Redwood contract id and the usage lines map back to the committed SKUs.
   - If you aggregate usage across multiple POs/entities, please ensure the PO references the master contract id; otherwise slab calculation may not include those lines.

3) Net terms:
   - Standard is Net-30. For larger, multi-year commitments we can consider Net-60 or Net-90 as a commercial concession tied to a committed spend band. Finance will evaluate credit exposure and may request a payment guarantee or early-invoice cadence as mitigation.

Proposed next step: can you share a sanitized sample PO (thank you for attaching) and let us know the expected invoice cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and whether you will expect a single consolidated invoice across entities? If you confirm monthly consolidated invoicing and inclusion of contract id on each PO we can commit to applying the discount slabs on the monthly invoice.

I'll loop in Ben for the billing / slab logic and Marissa for contract id / SOW pinning.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearwave.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwave.com
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO field / invoice cadence question (ClearWave)

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear guidance. Attaching a redacted PO and a note from our AP team on cadence.

- We expect monthly consolidated billing across three business units under a single master contract id.
- AP prefers Net-60 for new vendors; procurement will accept Net-30 if Finance requires it.
- The PO will include our erp_reference and a multi_entity_tag; we can add a custom field for Redwood contract id if you confirm the exact id format.

Attachments: ClearWave_PO_sample.pdf

Can Ben confirm whether mapping the erp_reference + contract id on the single monthly invoice will fully qualify the invoice for the committed discount calculation? Also, if Redwood requires line-by-line SKU matching on the invoice to demonstrate usage against committed SKUs, that would be good to know.

Appreciate it — Samantha
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearwave.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO field / invoice cadence question (ClearWave)

Hi Samantha — Ben from Billing here. I reviewed the PO sample and the AP note. Short answers: yes, and a small operational ask.

- Invoice mapping: We can map erp_reference + multi_entity_tag and treat the master contract id as the primary key for slab computation. As long as the monthly invoice references the PO number(s) and the master contract id, we will aggregate usage across those POs to evaluate discount tiers for that invoice period.
- Line-item detail: For consumption-based SKUs we require a line-item for each SKU with quantity/consumption and unit price (or a usage summary row per SKU). We do not need every token-level line — a summarized line per SKU with the usage quantity is sufficient for auditing discounts.
- Net terms: Net-60 is possible for the RDW-2027-CW-87321 commitment tier; Finance asked that we include an invoice-approval SLA in the SOW and a clause requiring the PO to include the contract id. That gives us the mitigation for extended credit.

Operational ask: Please ask AP to place the master contract id in the 'Customer Reference' field (we'll provide the contract id once SOW is countersigned). Also, please send the monthly consolidated invoice to billing@redwood.com and cc your internal PO owner.

I've attached our standard invoice template to speed onboarding.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
